offering_description.value: Provides a free digital platform for US physicians and other clinicians, offering professional networking, telehealth, and AI clinical search tools. It sells pharmaceutical and biotech marketing, clinical trial recruitment, and data solutions to life sciences companies, which fund most of its revenue.

primary_products.value: clinician networking app; telehealth software; AI clinical search tools; pharma marketing software

primary_services.value: pharma marketing campaigns; clinical trial recruitment; medical education content

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech companies, health systems and medical groups

revenue_model.value: advertising: pharma and biotech companies pay for physician-targeted marketing campaigns; service fees: clinical trial recruitment and related pharma services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: free clinician network and tools, sold to pharma companies for targeted reach; service provider: pharma marketing and trial recruitment services sold to life sciences companies

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide, serving US physicians and clinicians and pharma companies selling in the US

specialization.value: related lines: clinician network, telehealth, AI search tools, and pharma marketing and trial recruitment solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling marketing and trial services to pharma companies; online: free web and mobile platform used by physicians

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA privacy rules, FDA rules on pharma promotion, and state telehealth licensing rules
